Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this. We chatted with our AWS AE (Mike) last week and agreed it makes sense to start the ACE registration + co-sell path now so we can coordinate the marketplace listing and an initial enablement push in Q1. High level context: SkyForge is building an embeddings-based search product for logistics customers — we expect a pilot with a Fortune 100 retailer early next year.

Key asks to start:
- Confirm ACE eligibility and what artifacts you need from us (security questionnaire / SOC evidence / listing artifacts).
- Quick intro call with PDM + PSM to align on timelines and capacity expectations (we are chasing a couple of reserved pool options).
- Any notes on expected SKU/plan structure for the marketplace listing so we can prep pricing inputs.

I've attached a short intake sheet (skyforge-intake-summary.xlsx) — it has a summary of workloads and expected monthly token/instance needs.

Would early Tuesday (11/24) or Wednesday (11/25) work for a 30m sync?

Best,
Elena

Hi Elena — great to meet you virtually. Thanks for the intake sheet, that helps a lot.

Short answers up front:
- Eligibility: looks promising based on the intake. We typically need: completed security questionnaire (we can send our standard template), SOC2 attestations or equivalent, and marketplace SKU definitions (tiers/pricing + unit).
- PDM/PSM intro: yes — I've looped in Marissa (PDM) and Priyom (PSM) on this thread so we can schedule.
- Marketplace SKU guidance: we can share a short example and recommended packaging for co-sell-friendly listings.

Proposed next steps / agenda for a 30m call:
1) Quick intros (PDM / PSM / SkyForge GTM + AWS AE)
2) Confirm ACE eligibility checklist items and timing
3) Capacity / reserved pool expectation and any latency SLOs for pilot
4) Marketplace listing model & pricing format (who owns the SKU?)
5) Action items and owner assignment (DocuSign / artifact drop)

Availability: I have open windows 11/24 09:30-11:00 or 11/25 13:00-15:00 PT. Marissa / Priyom — can you confirm which slot works for you?

I'll circulate a brief one-page handshake checklist after the call and kick off the eligibility doc flow.

—Logan

Thanks, Logan + Elena. I'll be on the call and want to flag a few operational items so we can close faster:

Operational notes (for agenda / prep):
- Reserved capacity: need expected concurrent inference instances and peak qps per region (US-EAST/US-WEST) — Elena, the intake sheet has a starting estimate but we may ask for a short follow-up spreadsheet.
- KV cache & prefix reuse: if you expect many similar queries (search templates), we can recommend cache-friendly model variants to reduce cost.
- Rollout plan: PSM + SkyForge should decide pilot accounts, success metrics (latency < 200ms p95, cost per 1k tokens), and rollback triggers.
- Doc/Artifact owners: assign security packet to SkyForge; Redwood will supply marketplace SKU template + sample contract redline.

Marissa — would you mind preparing a PDM-side checklist for the call so we can tick off the ACE eligibility items (SOC2, data residency, KMS/HSM notes)?

Priyom

Thanks everyone — 11/25 13:00 PT works for our team.

Quick clarifications before the call:
- Security packet: we have a SOC2 report (ending 09/2026) and a short architecture diagram that shows we use AWS KMS. I will upload both to the Drive link you shared after we confirm the NDA flow.
- Marketplace SKU: we expect two SKUs (Starter: single-node inference, Pilot: multi-node with autoscale). If you have a naming/ID convention we should use, send it and we'll map.
- DocuSign: our legal asked for a standard co-sell MOU — I can start DocuSign once you give a preferred MOU template.

Looking forward to the call.

—Elena
